## Activity

During August 2025, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 37 captures. This report summarises activity for the month and provides the associated image quality and grading position. The recorded activity reflects the sessions completed at the clinic during the reporting period. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No further operational exception is noted in the information provided for this report.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. There was 1 ungradable capture, giving an ungradable rate of 2.7. The ungradable result should be retained in the activity record and considered alongside the total capture volume when reviewing monthly performance. The available information does not identify a further cause or pattern for the ungradable image.

## Grading

Grading identified 11 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This provides the central measure of the time taken for grading during August 2025. The grading outcome should be read together with the capture total and image quality measure, as these figures describe different stages of the same reporting process. Overall, the report records activity, image quality and grading outcomes for West Gate Eye Clinic without any additional exception being identified.
